# Document Viewer Dependencies

- Lucide 0.468.0, locally served UMD build from the published `lucide` package. License: `lucide-LICENSE.txt`.
- PDF.js 4.10.38, locally served module and worker from the published `pdfjs-dist` package. License: `pdfjs-4.10.38/LICENSE.txt`.

Versions are pinned. PDF.js is loaded only when opening a PDF.
